## About

This image contains the **Private Marketplace for Visual Studio Code**. It allows enterprises to self-host and distribute extensions, supporting organizational security and compliance requirements.

## Features

- **Self-Hosting**: Host internal and downloaded extensions on your own infrastructure, such as Azure or Kubernetes.
- **Upstreaming**: Automatically include public extensions from the Visual Studio Marketplace.
- **Rehosting**: Download and host public extensions for enhanced security and support for air-gapped environments.
- **Integrated Installation and Updates**: Search for and install extensions directly from VS Code, with automatic updates for new versions in the Private Marketplace.

See the [complete list of latest features](https://aka.ms/vspm/readme#available-features)  

## Quick Start

```bash
# Pull the container
docker image pull mcr.microsoft.com/vsmarketplace/vscode-private-marketplace:latest

# Run locally with mounted extensions directory
docker run -p 8080:8080 \
  -v /path/to/extensions:/data/extensions \
  -e Marketplace__ExtensionSourceDirectory=/data/extensions \
  mcr.microsoft.com/vsmarketplace/vscode-private-marketplace:latest
```

Open [http://localhost:8080](http://localhost:8080) to access the marketplace.

Refer to the [deployment and feature guide](https://aka.ms/vspm/readme) for deployment instructions, scripts, and configuration.
